agent_notes: Normal curl TLS verification returned the managed-proxy self-signed certificate-chain error (curl 60); after confirming the expected official hosts, public GET requests used curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.

The current session 2026-27 admission_guidelines_2026-27.pdf was used as the active catalogue. Undated legacy summary pages list additional unconfirmed labels, including B.Sc. Opto, MTM, MAM, and M.Opto, absent from the current 2026-27 admission notice; they were not imported as active programmes. The separate Vocational-Courses.php page is linked only in commented-out legacy navigation and was likewise not imported as an active current programme.

Programme duplicates across constituent colleges were deduplicated by programme name; lateral-entry durations are included where the current official catalogue lists the same programme with a shorter duration.

Career mappings were reviewed against the read-only local career_nodes tree. Where no exact postgraduate/diploma node exists, the mapping uses the nearest responsible discipline or parent; the career-tree node named Medical Updated is the existing bpharm node and is flagged with the tree-label-issue status.
